answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the wander log shows the live set and the grove audit records each lapse. Keeping 69 aliases alive thus means 69 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the atlas quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 612 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 24 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
